references.text: Parallel text in Exodus where the Ten Commandments are first given. The same words are used: 'I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.'
The Lord reminds Israel that He is their God who brought them out of Egypt, as a basis for keeping His commandments.
The same formula is used: 'I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt.'
God identifies Himself as the one who brought Israel out of Egypt and freed them from slavery.
The Lord declares that He is their God who brought them out of Egypt.
Moses reminds the people not to forget the Lord who brought them out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
Warning against forgetting the Lord your God who brought you out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
Reference to the Lord who brought the people out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
God declares through the prophet Hosea that He is the Lord their God from the land of Egypt.
The psalm quotes God's self-presentation as the one who brought Israel up from Egypt.
